$note: Sample inventory so a new deployment's marketplace is not empty, spread across enough of the world that the homepage rows populate for a visitor anywhere. Read by both prisma/seed.mjs (fresh databases) and prisma/sync-listings.mjs (databases that were already seeded); both create the named property if it does not exist yet. Prices are in each city's own currency and are never converted. Delete these rows once real hosts publish — `npm run db:sync-listings -- --list` names them.

listings.title: Studio in Westlands, walk to Sarit
listings.summary: Furnished studio, backup power, secure parking.
listings.description: A furnished studio on the third floor of a quiet block off Church Road, five minutes' walk from Sarit Centre. Borehole water, backup generator, lift serviced monthly, and 24-hour manned gate.

listings.title: Two-bed apartment, Kileleshwa
listings.summary: Corner unit with a balcony over the gardens.
listings.description: A bright two-bedroom corner apartment with a wrap-around balcony overlooking mature gardens. Fitted kitchen, master en-suite, borehole water and a generator covering the whole block.

listings.title: Beach cottage, Diani
listings.summary: Two minutes from the sand, under the palms.
listings.description: A thatched two-bedroom cottage set back from Diani beach road, with an outdoor shower, a shaded veranda and a short path through the palms to the sand. Breakfast can be arranged.

listings.title: Sea-view apartment, Nyali
listings.summary: Fourth floor, facing the water.
listings.description: A one-bedroom apartment on the fourth floor with an unbroken view over the channel. Pool and secure parking in the block; the beach is a ten-minute walk.

listings.title: Family house with garden, Karen
listings.summary: Half an acre, mature trees, staff quarters.
listings.description: A five-bedroom family house on half an acre in Karen, with mature indigenous trees, a borehole, solar water heating, staff quarters and a double garage. Title deed ready.

listings.title: Serviced apartment, Upper Hill
listings.summary: Weekly housekeeping, walk to the hospitals.
listings.description: A serviced two-bedroom apartment among the Upper Hill offices, with weekly housekeeping, a gym in the building and fibre throughout. Convenient for the hospitals and the CBD.

listings.title: Townhouse in Nyali, three bed
listings.summary: Gated court of eight, shared pool.
listings.description: A three-bedroom townhouse in a gated court of eight units off Links Road, sharing a pool and a generator. All bedrooms en-suite, with a small private garden behind.

listings.title: One-bed in Kilimani, furnished
listings.summary: Short stays, walk to Yaya.
listings.description: A furnished one-bedroom for short stays, five minutes from Yaya Centre. Fast fibre, a proper desk, and a lift that works.

listings.title: Lakefront cottage, Naivasha
listings.summary: Fever trees, fire pit, hippos at dusk.
listings.description: A two-bedroom cottage on a fenced plot running down to the lake, under yellow-barked fever trees. Fire pit, outdoor kitchen and a caretaker on site. Hell's Gate is twenty minutes away.

listings.title: Farmhouse with a view, Naivasha
listings.summary: Whole farmhouse, sleeps eight.
listings.description: A working farm's guest house with a wide veranda facing the escarpment. Four bedrooms, a long kitchen table, solar hot water and a generator for the evenings.

listings.title: Two-bed cabin near the lake
listings.summary: Long lets, ten minutes from town.
listings.description: A timber-clad two-bedroom cabin on a smallholding ten minutes from Naivasha town, let by the month. Borehole water, solar, and space to park two cars.

listings.title: Cabin under Mount Kenya
listings.summary: The mountain from the bed, on a clear morning.
listings.description: A stone-and-timber cabin at 2,100 metres with the peak framed in the bedroom window. Wood stove, hot water from solar, and blankets enough for the cold nights.

listings.title: Ridge house with fireplace, Nanyuki
listings.summary: Open fire, big windows, quiet.
listings.description: A three-bedroom house on a ridge outside Nanyuki, with an open fire in the sitting room and windows down one whole side. Ol Pejeta is an hour; the airstrip is fifteen minutes.

listings.title: Four-acre plot with borehole, Nanyuki
listings.summary: Four acres, water, and a house already on it.
listings.description: Four fenced acres on the Timau road with an existing three-bedroom house, a producing borehole and mains power. Title deed ready, survey done.

listings.title: Apartment above Camps Bay
listings.summary: Twelve Apostles behind, Atlantic in front.
listings.description: A two-bedroom apartment on the slope above Camps Bay beach, with the mountains behind and the sea from the balcony. Ten minutes to the V&A by car.

listings.title: Sea Point studio, walk to the promenade
listings.summary: Two streets from the sea wall.
listings.description: A compact studio two streets back from the Sea Point promenade, with a proper desk, fast fibre and a secure garage bay. Restaurants on the corner.

listings.title: Family house in Constantia
listings.summary: Oaks, a pool, and the vineyards behind.
listings.description: A four-bedroom family house on a quiet Constantia lane, with old oaks, a north-facing pool and the vineyards up the hill. Double garage and a cottage at the back.

listings.title: Woodstock loft with a desk
listings.summary: Converted warehouse, long lets.
listings.description: A one-bedroom loft in a converted Woodstock warehouse, let by the month. Concrete floors, tall windows, fibre, and a co-working floor downstairs.

listings.title: Marina apartment with a balcony
listings.summary: The walk downstairs, the water in front.
listings.description: A one-bedroom apartment on the twenty-second floor overlooking the marina, with a balcony, a shared pool and gym, and the Marina Walk at street level.

listings.title: Downtown studio near the fountain
listings.summary: Ten minutes' walk to the Burj.
listings.description: A studio in Downtown with a fitted kitchen, a desk by the window and a view down the boulevard. The fountain show is a ten-minute walk; the metro is closer.

listings.title: Palm Jumeirah three-bed
listings.summary: Beach access, sleeps six.
listings.description: A three-bedroom apartment on the Palm with direct beach access, a large terrace and a shared pool. Parking for two, and a supermarket in the building.

listings.title: Two-bed in Jumeirah Village
listings.summary: Annual lets, quiet circle.
listings.description: A two-bedroom apartment in a low-rise block in JVC, let annually. Covered parking, a shared pool, and a park across the road.

listings.title: Corniche apartment with sea view
listings.summary: The Gulf from the living room.
listings.description: A two-bedroom apartment facing the Corniche, with the beach across the road and the cycle path below. Covered parking and a pool on the podium.

listings.title: Saadiyat studio near the museums
listings.summary: Walk to the Louvre.
listings.description: A quiet studio on Saadiyat with a desk, blackout blinds and a short walk to the Louvre Abu Dhabi. Beach club access included.

listings.title: Family villa in Khalifa City
listings.summary: Garden, maid's room, annual let.
listings.description: A four-bedroom villa in a compound in Khalifa City, with a walled garden, a maid's room and shared pool and gym. Fifteen minutes from the airport.

listings.title: Södermalm apartment with a balcony
listings.summary: Top floor, over the rooftops.
listings.description: A two-bedroom flat on the top floor of a 1920s block on Hornsgatan, with a small balcony over the courtyard. Ten minutes' walk to Slussen and the ferries.

listings.title: Studio in Vasastan
listings.summary: Quiet street, fast fibre.
listings.description: A studio on a quiet Vasastan street with a proper desk, a good chair and fibre throughout. Two minutes to the metro, five to Vasaparken.

listings.title: Archipelago house, sleeps six
listings.summary: Own jetty, an hour from town.
listings.description: A red timber house on Värmdö with its own jetty, a sauna and a rowing boat. An hour from Stockholm by car, and the water is swimmable from June.

listings.title: One-bed in Kungsholmen
listings.summary: Long lets by the water.
listings.description: A one-bedroom flat on Kungsholmen let by the month, a street back from the Mälaren shore path. Laundry in the building, bike storage in the courtyard.

listings.title: Haga flat with a bay window
listings.summary: Cobbles below, cinnamon buns on the corner.
listings.description: A one-bedroom flat in a wooden Haga landshövdingehus, with a bay window over the cobbles. The café on the corner is the reason people come to Haga.

listings.title: Two-bed near Avenyn
listings.summary: Walk to everything.
listings.description: A two-bedroom flat off Avenyn, five minutes from Götaplatsen and the concert hall. High ceilings, a long kitchen table, and a tram stop outside.

listings.title: House with a garden in Majorna
listings.summary: Wooden house, apple trees, near the river.
listings.description: A four-bedroom wooden house in Majorna with apple trees and a greenhouse, ten minutes from the river and the Klippan ferry. Roof replaced in 2021.

listings.title: Le Marais one-bed
listings.summary: Third floor, no lift, worth it.
listings.description: A one-bedroom on the third floor of a seventeenth-century building on rue des Archives, with beams, a small kitchen and windows onto the street. No lift.

listings.title: Studio near Canal Saint-Martin
listings.summary: Two streets from the canal.
listings.description: A quiet studio two streets from the Canal Saint-Martin, with a desk, a good mattress and a boulangerie underneath. République is a seven-minute walk.

listings.title: Family apartment in the 15e
listings.summary: Sleeps six, lift, quiet courtyard.
listings.description: A three-bedroom apartment on a courtyard in the 15th, with a lift, a proper family kitchen and a park at the end of the road. Montparnasse in fifteen minutes.

listings.title: Pied-à-terre near Bastille
listings.summary: Two bedrooms, fifth floor, lift.
listings.description: A two-bedroom apartment on the fifth floor near Bastille, with a lift, parquet throughout and a cellar. Building renovated in 2019.

listings.title: Villa with a pool in Seminyak
listings.summary: Private pool, walled garden, ten minutes to the beach.
listings.description: A two-bedroom villa behind a wall off Jalan Kayu Aya, with a private pool, an open-sided living room and frangipani over the water. Staff come daily.

listings.title: Rice-field house in Ubud
listings.summary: The terraces start at the veranda.
listings.description: A one-bedroom house on the edge of the rice terraces north of Ubud, with an open bathroom, a day bed on the veranda and nothing but the fields in front.

listings.title: Surf house in Canggu
listings.summary: Boards in the garage, break down the lane.
listings.description: A three-bedroom house a lane back from Batu Bolong, with board storage, an outdoor shower and a shared pool. The break is a two-minute walk.

listings.title: Long-stay villa, Umalas
listings.summary: Monthly lets, desk and fibre.
listings.description: A two-bedroom villa in Umalas let by the month, with a pool, a covered workspace and fibre that holds up for calls. Scooter parking behind the gate.

listings.title: Stone Town house with a roof terrace
listings.summary: Carved doors, and the rooftops at sunset.
listings.description: A two-bedroom house in Shangani with a carved door, a courtyard and a roof terrace looking over the old town to the water. The fish market is five minutes.

listings.title: Beach bungalow, Paje
listings.summary: Straight onto the sand.
listings.description: A thatched bungalow on the beach at Paje, with a veranda facing east for the sunrise and a kite school two doors down. Breakfast included.

listings.title: Nungwi villa with a pool
listings.summary: Pool, cook, and the north beach.
listings.description: A three-bedroom villa above Nungwi beach with a pool, a cook who comes in the morning and a path down to the sand. The dhow trips leave from below.

listings.title: Shoreditch loft
listings.summary: Warehouse conversion off Rivington Street.
listings.description: A one-bedroom loft in a converted warehouse off Rivington Street, with tall windows, a desk and a lift. Old Street is a six-minute walk.

listings.title: Two-bed in Bermondsey
listings.summary: Between the river and the Blue.
listings.description: A two-bedroom flat in Bermondsey with a small terrace, ten minutes from Tower Bridge on foot and five from the Jubilee line. Bermondsey Street on the doorstep.

listings.title: Garden flat in Peckham
listings.summary: Own garden, monthly let.
listings.description: A two-bedroom garden flat in Peckham let by the month, with its own patch behind and a shed. Rye Lane is five minutes; the overground is seven.

listings.title: Riad with a courtyard pool
listings.summary: Inside the walls, cool all day.
listings.description: A restored riad off Derb Sidi Bouloukat with a plunge pool in the courtyard, zellige to head height and a roof terrace for breakfast. Jemaa el-Fna is a six-minute walk.

listings.title: Room in a riad, Medina
listings.summary: One room, breakfast on the roof.
listings.description: A double room with an en-suite in a small family-run riad, breakfast served on the roof terrace. The hosts arrange the airport transfer and the hammam.

listings.title: Villa in the Palmeraie
listings.summary: Palms, a long pool, and the Atlas behind.
listings.description: A four-bedroom villa in the Palmeraie with a twenty-metre pool, a walled garden of olives and palms, and the Atlas on the horizon. Staff and a cook included.

listings.title: Loft in Westlands, short stays
listings.summary: Mezzanine bedroom, walk to the restaurants.
listings.description: A double-height loft off Woodvale Grove with the bed on the mezzanine and a desk below. Backup power, secure parking, and Westlands on the doorstep.

listings.title: Old Town apartment, Mombasa
listings.summary: Carved balcony over the lane.
listings.description: A two-bedroom apartment in a restored Old Town building, with a carved wooden balcony over the lane and the fort five minutes away. Ceiling fans and air conditioning in both rooms.

listings.title: Studio by the lake gate, Naivasha
listings.summary: Small, quiet, and close to the water.
listings.description: A one-room studio by the gate of a lakeside plot, with a kitchenette, a shaded stoop and the water a two-minute walk through the acacias.

listings.title: Two-bed near the airstrip, Nanyuki
listings.summary: Ten minutes from the strip, good for an early flight.
listings.description: A two-bedroom cottage ten minutes from Nanyuki airstrip, with a wood stove, hot water from solar and a caretaker who will do breakfast if asked the night before.

listings.title: Beachfront villa, Diani
listings.summary: On the sand, with a cook and a pool.
listings.description: A four-bedroom villa directly on Diani beach, with a pool, a cook and a housekeeper included, and the reef a short swim out. Askari on the gate day and night.

listings.title: Garden cottage, Diani
listings.summary: Set back in the trees, five minutes to the sand.
listings.description: A one-bedroom cottage in a garden of frangipani and coconut palms, five minutes' walk from the beach road crossing. Mosquito nets, a fan, and a hammock.
